Concerts, theatre and comedy

A stage of your own, not a slot in a list.

Your page carries your logo, colours and typefaces through to checkout and the link people share on WhatsApp. Nobody else's shows sit beside yours.

  • Season and festival passes: one code for every night, never oversold
  • Ask buyers questions before they pay, and download the answers
  • Artist share links show which performer brought each buyer
  • An About page with real attendance counted at the door

Safaris, reserves and stays

Every drive, every seat, booked straight from you.

Visitors pick a date and a drive, see seats left in each vehicle and pay. Your rules hold on their own: how far ahead, when online booking closes, how many per booking.

  • Time slots, vehicle types and live seat counts
  • Cottages and rooms with multi-night stays
  • Visitor ID details collected before the drive
  • Refunds by your own slabs, worked out automatically

The counter

Walk-ins sell in seconds, and count in the same books.

Pick the slot, the vehicle and how many. Take cash, UPI or card, and the passes print or go to the visitor's WhatsApp. Counter sales sit in the same ledger as online ones.

  • Cash, UPI and card, with a printed receipt
  • Passes on WhatsApp if the visitor gives a number
  • In-person sales pay only our fee, no gateway charge
  • A running total for each counter, every day

Fleet and drivers

The morning trip sheet, already filled in.

Every vehicle on a drive, its seats taken and its driver, on one page you can print for the gate. Assign drivers from a list; idle vehicles show up in your reports.

  • Seats per vehicle across online and counter sales
  • Drivers assigned per drive, printable for the gate
  • Vehicle papers tracked: fitness, permit, insurance, PUC

The door

One code for the whole party. No app for your volunteers.

Every booking gets a pass with a short door code that works for the whole group. Volunteers open your check-in link, sign in with their phone and the event passcode, and scan.

  • Passes by WhatsApp and email, saved in My tickets
  • Volunteers need a link and a passcode, nothing to install
  • A live count of who's in, as they arrive

Your console

Set it up once. Change it any time.

Your logo, tagline, story and background video live in one place. A short checklist gets you from nothing to on sale, and settlement shows every rupee from gross to what lands in your account.

  • A getting-ready checklist from signup to first sale
  • Settlement itemised: gross, gateway, our fee and its GST
  • Exports of every buyer, answer and pass, whenever you want them

In a list, you’re one goat in the herd.

Listings sort you by date, rank you by price and put three other evenings beside yours. Your own page answers only one question: are you coming to this show?

Leave the herd. Be the G.O.A.T.
